description:
The purpose of this special notice is to notify industry of the transfer of Department of the Interior Order Number 140D0425F0941, issued under GSA MAS 47QTCA18D00KV, awarded to The Manhattan Strategy Group LLC, on September 09, 2025, to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) under new Order Number 7571MN26F80016, effective March 29, 2026.

All terms and conditions of the original order remain unchanged, including:
- Ultimate Order Value
- Period of Performance

This administrative transfer does not alter the scope of work, deliverables, or any other contractual obligations.
